svg.title: Logic-SNN: MNIST method
svg.desc: MNIST large identity-middle architecture verified against Logic-SNN commit cd6805c93368c8af99122066f33e72ca78bd401a. Binary input 1x28x28 is repeated for four timesteps. Convolutional logic trees use eight fixed leaves and seven gates, shared spatially; each tree is followed by current gain, LIF, and 2x2 max pooling. Pooled shapes are 96x14x14 and 192x7x7. Flattened width 9408 feeds dense logic-spike layers 8192, 8192, and 20480. The middle dense layer is initialized toward identity A. Class-group and temporal mean yields ten rates with 2048 units per class. Training uses soft gate mixtures, ATan surrogate gradients and BPTT; hard export selects argmax gates and preserves wiring, gain, LIF dynamics, and readout. Input is MNIST test image zero, shown as native vector pixel cells; intermediate feature patterns, membrane traces, spike rasters and illustrative operator selection are schematic, not recorded activations or predictions. Style references: BIPNet Fig.1, Burstormer Fig.2, Restormer Fig.2, and the user-approved pipeline SVG style.

g.text: Blue: forward flow Green: logic Orange: gain / LIF

g.data-reduction: mean over timesteps and class-group units
